title: Reliable Email Delivery
description: Fix WordPress emails that never arrive — SMTP setup, DNS records, and delivery testing.

steps.title: Choose an Email Provider
steps.instructions: Pick a transactional provider (host mail, SendGrid, Mailgun, Amazon SES, etc.) instead of default PHP mail on shared hosting.

steps.title: Install & Configure SMTP Plugin
steps.instructions: Install WP Mail SMTP or similar. Enter SMTP host, port, encryption, and authenticated sender credentials.

steps.title: Set From Name & From Email
steps.instructions: Use a domain you control (e.g. noreply@yourdomain.com). Match the From address to SPF/DKIM authorized senders.

steps.title: Add SPF, DKIM & DMARC DNS Records
steps.instructions: Publish DNS records from your email provider. DMARC can start at p=none while monitoring deliverability.

steps.title: Send Test Email from WordPress
steps.instructions: Use the plugin's test feature or trigger a password reset. Confirm delivery to inbox—not spam folder.

steps.title: Test Form & WooCommerce Emails
steps.instructions: Submit contact forms and place a test order if applicable. Verify admin notifications and customer receipts arrive.

steps.title: Enable Email Logging (Optional)
steps.instructions: Turn on email logging temporarily to debug failures. Disable or purge logs after confirming delivery works.
